header.title: Разработка ПО
header.subtitle: Custom Software Development for Modern Businesses
header.description: From full-stack web applications to mobile apps and cloud-native APIs, we build custom software solutions using React, Next.js, Node.js, Flutter, and Python. Our agile development process delivers high-quality software that scales with your business.

overview.title: Service Overview
overview.content: Our Custom Software Development service delivers end-to-end solutions tailored to your business needs. We specialise in modern technology stacks including React and Next.js for web applications, Node.js for backend services, Flutter for cross-platform mobile apps, and Python for data-intensive applications and automation. Every project follows our proven agile methodology, ensuring transparency, quality, and timely delivery. From requirements analysis and UI/UX design through development, testing, and deployment, we handle the complete software development lifecycle.

features.title: Requirements Analysis
features.description: Thorough analysis of your business requirements, user needs, and technical constraints to define a clear project scope and specification.

features.title: UI/UX Design
features.description: User-centred design process including wireframing, prototyping, and usability testing to create intuitive and engaging user experiences.

features.title: Agile Development
features.description: Iterative development with two-week sprints, regular demos, and continuous feedback loops ensuring alignment with your vision.

features.title: API Development
features.description: Design and implementation of RESTful and GraphQL APIs with comprehensive documentation, authentication, and rate limiting.

features.title: Testing & QA
features.description: Comprehensive testing strategy including unit tests, integration tests, end-to-end tests, and performance testing for production readiness.

features.title: Deployment & Maintenance
features.description: Cloud-native deployment on AWS, Azure, or GCP with CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance and support.

pricing.title: Цены
pricing.description: Engagements starting from £4,000. Priced based on project scope and complexity.

steps.title: Discovery & Planning
steps.description: We work with you to understand your business goals, define requirements, and create a detailed project plan with clear milestones.

steps.title: Design & Prototyping
steps.description: Our designers create wireframes and interactive prototypes, iterating based on your feedback until the design is approved.

steps.title: Development Sprints
steps.description: Our engineers build your application in agile sprints, delivering working increments every two weeks for your review.

steps.title: Testing & Launch
steps.description: We conduct thorough testing, fix any issues, and deploy your application to production with full monitoring in place.

steps.title: Support & Evolution
steps.description: We provide ongoing maintenance, performance monitoring, and feature development to keep your software evolving with your business.

cta.title: Ready to Get Started?
cta.description: Bring your software idea to life. Book a consultation to discuss your project requirements.
